notes: Train/validation/test are 100/60/40 target tickets, grouped by product area. Related booking, maintenance, and kit cases stay in train; checkout, identity, and integration cases stay in validation; return, overdue, audit, and reporting cases stay in test. Audit cases may cite shared incident-access source rules from the training documentation. All project docs and pre-cutoff completed history may be indexed at evaluation time. This is a within-project feature holdout, not an unseen-project benchmark.
